allow: PowerShell($file = "C:\\tmp\\.env.netlify-prod"; Write-Host "File exists: $\(Test-Path $file\)"; Write-Host "File size: $\(\(Get-Item $file\).Length\) bytes"; Write-Host "Total lines: $\(\(Get-Content $file\).Count\)"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Lines starting with MAIL_FROM_NAME or INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD:"; Get-Content $file -Encoding UTF8 | Select-String -Pattern '^\(MAIL_FROM_NAME|INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD\)' | ForEach-Object { $line = $_.Line; $eqIdx = $line.IndexOf\('='\); $key = $line.Substring\(0, $eqIdx\); $val = $line.Substring\($eqIdx + 1\); $len = $val.Length; Write-Host "  $key= \(value length: $len\)" })

PowerShell($json = netlify env:list --json --context production; $envs = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; $names = $envs.PSObject.Properties.Name; Write-Host "Total: $\($names.Count\) variables"; Write-Host ""; $required = "DATABASE_URL","DIRECT_URL","NEXTAUTH_URL","NEXTAUTH_SECRET","NODE_VERSION","CRON_SECRET","MAIL_PROVIDER","BREVO_API_KEY","MAIL_FROM","MAIL_FROM_NAME","ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","VOYAGE_API_KEY","INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL","INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD","SUPER_ADMIN_INITIAL_EMAIL","SUPER_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD","SUPER_ADMIN_INITIAL_NAME"; $missing = $required | Where-Object { $names -notcontains $_ }; if \($missing\) { Write-Host "MISSING: $\($missing -join ', '\)" } else { Write-Host "All 17 required keys registered." }; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Registered keys \(sorted\):"; $names | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" })

PowerShell(Write-Host "=== Check secret keys in PRODUCTION context ==="; @\("NEXTAUTH_SECRET","CRON_SECRET","BREVO_API_KEY","ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","VOYAGE_API_KEY","INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD","SUPER_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD"\) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host -NoNewline "  $_ : "; $out = netlify env:get $_ --context production 2>&1; if \($out -match "No value set"\) { Write-Host "NOT SET" -ForegroundColor Red } else { Write-Host "SET" -ForegroundColor Green } })

PowerShell($cpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor; Write-Host "CPU VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled: $\($cpu.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled\)"; Write-Host "CPU SecondLevelAddressTranslationExtensions: $\($cpu.SecondLevelAddressTranslationExtensions\)"; Write-Host "---"; $hv = Get-ComputerInfo -Property HyperVisorPresent,WindowsProductName,OsArchitecture; $hv | Format-List; Write-Host "---"; wsl --status 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 10)
